pages.title: Pages
pages.subtitle: Build every Showcase Website page from reusable, drag-and-drop sections.
pages.empty_body: Create your first page to start building the public site.
pages.delete_body: This permanently removes the page and all of its sections.

pages.auto_section: This section pulls live data automatically — no manual configuration needed yet.
pages.no_editor: No editor built for this section type yet.

programmes.title: Programmes
programmes.subtitle: Manage every football programme shown on the public site, including schedules, coaches and pricing.

programmes.banner_link: Banner link (optional, defaults to booking URL)

redirects.title: Redirects

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.subtitle: Moderate and respond to customer reviews.
reviews.empty_body: Reviews submitted through the website will appear here.
reviews.delete_body: This will permanently delete the review. This action cannot be undone.

sponsors.subtitle: Manage sponsor logos displayed on the public website. New sponsors appear automatically.
sponsors.empty_body: Add your first sponsor logo to display it on the website.
sponsors.remove_body: This will permanently remove the sponsor.

squads.title: Development Squad Registrations
squads.subtitle: Interest registrations submitted from the public Development Squads page.

schedule.title: Location Schedules
schedule.subtitle: Every location has its own independent timetable. Pick a location to view and edit only its slots.
schedule.no_locations: No locations available. Create a station first — its schedule is created with it.
schedule.empty_body: Add the first training slot, or start from another location's schedule as a template.
schedule.field_hint: Pitch or terrain within this location. Two active slots on the same pitch, day and time are rejected. Leave empty if the location has only one pitch.
schedule.active_hint: Inactive slots stay saved but are hidden from the public site and skipped by conflict checks.
schedule.no_conflict_check: This value does not name a single weekday, so this slot is excluded from conflict checks.
schedule.error_overlap: Clashes with {{name}} ({{day}} {{start}}–{{end}}) on {{field}}. Change the time, the day or the pitch.
schedule.error_overlap_generic: This slot clashes with another one at the same location, day, time and pitch.
schedule.error_time_order: The end time must be after the start time.
schedule.programme_tab_hint: These slots belong to locations. To edit a whole location's timetable, go to Website → Schedules.
